note: What each kind of villager does and how it feeds the village. This is the village's job logic: scripted, labelled, and grounded in the same facts the dashboard shows. `topics` are words that make a villager of that role answer from live facts.

builder.title: Builders
builder.purpose: Raise the public works with a crew.
builder.daily: Dawn at the market hall and the well, by day at the cottages and the annex, at dusk at the orchard gate and the observatory.
builder.gives: A stage is built only while two or more people, builders included, stand at its site.

farmer.title: Farmers
farmer.purpose: Grow the food the pantry shares.
farmer.daily: Dawn at the vertical farm and the solar array, dusk in the glass garden; market hour at the plaza.
farmer.gives: Their harvest is why the pantry is restocked; soil science and vertical farming raise the yield.

maker.title: Makers
maker.purpose: Craft tools, furniture and lamps for the village.
maker.daily: By day at the field pavilion; market hour at the plaza.
maker.gives: They stand with the pavilion crew and lay out their craft at market hour.

scholar.title: Scholars
scholar.purpose: Record discoveries and push the research queue forward.
scholar.daily: Dawn at the research tower, dusk at the observatory; story circle on the half hour.
scholar.gives: Insight comes from the facts they write down: places found, stages built, events held.

courier.title: Couriers
courier.purpose: Carry news between places so no one is left out.
courier.daily: By day they walk the sky walk and carry news; market hour at the plaza.
courier.gives: They bring the day's chronicle to whoever asks.

keeper.title: Keepers
keeper.purpose: Host gatherings and look after the shared spaces.
keeper.daily: Dawn at the transit hub, by day at the open archive, dusk at the light fountain; they lead the story circle.
keeper.gives: They know the schedule of market hour, story circle and the weekly festival.
